world.title: Russia's ruling pro-Putin party wins wartime election with over 57% of vote, near-complete results show
world.summary: Russia's ruling United Russia party won over 57% of the votes in a Parliamentary election, according to near-complete results from the Central Election Commission. This election, framed by President Vladimir Putin as a measure of support for the ongoing war in Ukraine, allows the party to maintain its majority in the State Duma amid the conflict.

world.title: F-35 parts diverted to Hong Kong: What is the US stealth fighter, and why a lost canopy is a worry
world.summary: A Pentagon investigation is underway after F-35 parts, including a canopy, were diverted to Hong Kong during transit. The F-35's stealth capabilities stem from its unique design and radar-absorbent materials, which reduce its visibility to radar. The canopy is particularly concerning as it is not a routine component, raising security and operational implications for the advanced fighter jet.

business.title: Honda CB500 Launched in India Starting At Rs. 2.75 Lakh
business.summary: The Honda CB500 has been officially launched in India, with prices starting at Rs. 2.75 lakh (ex-showroom, Bengaluru) and going up to Rs. 3.01 lakh. The motorcycle is available in three variants, and bookings have commenced through Honda BigWing dealerships. This launch marks Honda's entry into the mid-range motorcycle segment in the Indian market.

business.title: Electric Two-Wheeler Sales August 2026 India: TVS, Bajaj, Ather, Vida
business.summary: In August 2026, the electric two-wheeler market in India recorded sales of 187,214 units, demonstrating significant year-over-year growth. The Bajaj Chetak emerged as the top-selling electric scooter, while the combined sales of the TVS iQube and Orbiter exceeded 57,000 units. This trend highlights the increasing popularity of electric vehicles in the Indian two-wheeler segment.

business.title: Stellantis Buys Out CK Birla Stake In Citroen India Plant - Targets 43k Production By 2028
business.summary: Stellantis has fully acquired CK Birla's stake in the Citroen India plant, gaining complete ownership of Stellantis Automobiles India. The company aims to increase annual production at its Thiruvallur facility to over 43,000 units by 2028. In the past year, Citroen and Jeep combined achieved 14,342 domestic sales, indicating a focus on expanding their market presence in India.

technology.title: Xiaomi 18 Pro series launch date confirmed: New privacy display and Starry River Blue colour teased
technology.summary: Xiaomi has confirmed the launch date for the Xiaomi 18 Pro series, set for September 23, 2026, at 7 pm local time in China (4:30 pm IST). The series is anticipated to feature the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max. Ahead of the event, the company has teased details about the design, display, and color options.

technology.title: Townfall Review Scores: Metacritic 81 [2026]
technology.summary: Silent Hill: Townfall received a score of 81 on Metacritic ahead of its September 24, 2026 launch on PlayStation 5 and PC. The review embargo lifted on September 21, revealing a mix of praise and criticism from critics. The first-person survival horror spin-off has garnered attention for its unique approach, though some concerns have been raised regarding its execution.

technology.title: Samsung and LG vow to remove 'botnet' apps from their smart TV app stores that turned sets into an AI scraping machines — but the shocking claim that over 40% of webOS apps had botnet code raises the
technology.summary: Samsung and LG have committed to eliminating 'botnet' applications from their smart TV app stores, following reports that over 40% of webOS apps contained botnet code. These malware botnets exploit smart TVs to route internet traffic. Other platforms, including Roku and Fire TV, are also affected, prompting manufacturers to take action against the compromised applications.

sports.title: India vs Bangladesh Highlights, Kabaddi at Asian Games 2026: IND 42-21 BAN; Indian team leads at half-time
sports.summary: In the women's kabaddi competition at the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, India defeated Bangladesh 42-21, leading at half-time. The match featured India's first all-out against Bangladesh, which prompted a review for a bonus point that was ultimately awarded. This game marks the opening of India's group-stage campaign in the tournament.

sports.title: ‘I had no choice’: MMA fighter Varun Sanyal breaks silence after weight-cut blackout, calls himself ‘foolish’
sports.summary: Indian MMA fighter Varun Sanyal has addressed his recent withdrawal from the Asian Games after experiencing a blackout during a sauna session. He described his weight-cutting attempt as “foolish” and acknowledged that he had no choice but to step back from the competition. Sanyal's incident highlights the risks associated with extreme weight management in combat sports.

sports.title: ‘Hide your face’: Wasim Akram rips into Razaullah celebrations after Pakistan are hammered by England
sports.summary: Wasim Akram criticized the celebrations for Razaullah following Pakistan's 3-0 defeat to England, describing them as indicative of "accepted mediocrity" in cricket. The series highlighted Pakistan's recurring weaknesses, particularly in batting, which struggled under pressure. The final Test at Edgbaston further emphasized these issues, leaving the team with little to celebrate upon their return from England.

health.title: What SIRPα reveals about how breast cancer takes hold in the brain
health.summary: Researchers at Wake Forest University School of Medicine have discovered a significant role for SIRPα in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC). This cell-surface protein is linked to mitochondrial fission, tumor-cell migration, and the suppression of the brain's immune defenses. The findings suggest that SIRPα may facilitate cancer cells' survival and establishment in the brain.

health.title: PGIMER Sounds Alarm on Rising Dementia Burden; Stresses Early Diagnosis and Caregiver Support
health.summary: On World Alzheimer’s Day, PGIMER's Department of Neurology in Chandigarh highlighted the growing burden of dementia, emphasizing the need for increased public awareness. They stressed the importance of early diagnosis and support for caregivers to improve outcomes for patients. The call to action aims to address the rising incidence of Alzheimer’s disease and other dementias in society.

health.title: Study suggests human brain may have evolved as two independent organs
health.summary: A new study suggests the human brain may have evolved as two independent organs over hundreds of millions of years, challenging the current understanding of brain development. This research indicates that the brain's structure and function could be more complex than previously thought, potentially reshaping scientific perspectives on neurological evolution and the organization of cognitive processes in humans.

science.title: NASA’s Moon orbiter found a 700-foot crater that wasn’t there before - and it's created a strange cold spot
science.summary: NASA scientists have discovered a new 700-foot crater on the Moon, named McGetchin, which was not present in previous observations. This crater is the largest newly-formed crater recorded in the Solar System. The discovery includes a peculiar cold spot associated with the crater, raising questions about its formation and the Moon's geological activity. Further studies are planned.

science.title: NIT-Srinagar to open campus observatory with 14-inch telescope
science.summary: NIT-Srinagar will inaugurate a campus observatory featuring a 14-inch Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope, developed in collaboration with the Indian Institute of Astrophysics. This facility will make NIT-Srinagar the first National Institute of Technology in India to have a dedicated observatory on campus. Officials announced the opening date as September 21, marking a significant advancement in the institute's research capabilities.

science.title: Progress 96 reaches ISS with food, fuel and other supplies
science.summary: Russia's Progress 96 spacecraft successfully docked with the International Space Station's Poisk module after a three-day journey from the Baikonur Cosmodrome. It delivered approximately three tonnes of supplies, including food, fuel, and equipment, to support the seven astronauts and cosmonauts currently aboard the ISS. This resupply mission is essential for maintaining operations and living conditions in the station.

entertainment.title: Actor Radha accuses sister Ambika, brother of cheque fraud worth Rs 46 crore
entertainment.summary: Actor Radha has filed a complaint with the Greater Chennai Police against her sister Ambika and brother Mallikarjuna Kunjan Nair, accusing them of cheque fraud amounting to Rs 46 crore. She alleges that five signed blank cheques, kept at her Chennai residence, were accessed without her consent and presented for encashment. The investigation is ongoing.

entertainment.title: Tamannaah Bhatia’s House of Masaba look is the perfect definition of old-world romance with a modest edge
entertainment.summary: Tamannaah Bhatia showcased a unique style in her latest House of Masaba look, blending old-world Indian glamour with modern elegance. Her ensemble emphasizes modesty while maintaining a polished silhouette, avoiding skin-baring trends. The richness of the outfit, characterized by its elegant proportions and nostalgic aesthetic, captures attention without relying on overt maximalism, highlighting a sophisticated approach to fashion.

entertainment.title: Team 'Hanuman Ansh' meets Amit Shah in Delhi after the film crosses Rs 300 crore, Home Minister speaks about Neem Karoli Baba during interaction
entertainment.summary: The team of the film 'Hanuman Ansh' met Union Home Minister Amit Shah in New Delhi after the movie surpassed Rs 300 crore at the box office. Director Vishal Chaturvedi and lead actor Shobhinaw Satyaa attended the meeting. During their interaction, Shah spoke about Neem Karoli Baba, highlighting the film's cultural significance and its impact on audiences.
